faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about Pickup.

items.question: What is Pickup?
items.answer: Pickup is a self-pickup food-ordering platform. You order ahead from nearby restaurants and collect your meal in store.

items.question: Is Pickup pickup-only?
items.answer: Yes. Pickup is a self-pickup service — you collect your order in store the moment it's ready.

items.question: How do I know when my order is ready?
items.answer: The restaurant updates your order status in real time, and you'll get a notification when it's ready to collect.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Pay securely in the app using your preferred payment method before you arrive.

items.question: Is Pickup free to use?
items.answer: Yes. The app is free to download, and there are no hidden service fees.

items.question: Can I reorder my favourites?
items.answer: Yes. Save your favourite items and repeat past orders with a single tap.
